tagline: 8 to 12 stocks, each with a reason to own it and a reason to sell
mandate: Long-only equities. No leverage, no structured products
About 20% a year over a 30-year horizon
6 months to 10 years, set by the edge the position relies on

Patience.source: A durable moat the market has temporarily mispriced, held for longer than 95% of participants will wait
Patience.broken: The moat erodes or return on capital falls structurally

Informational.source: A business explainable in one sentence, under-followed by professional capital, with the narrative still undeveloped
Informational.broken: The narrative arrives and the price re-rates

Catalyst.source: A specific, dated event that forces a re-rating within a defined window
Catalyst.broken: The catalyst fires, or the window slips indefinitely

criteria: ROIC of 15–20% or more over several years, measured all-in, including goodwill actually paid
The business fits in one sentence and the market narrative is still underdeveloped
An identifiable catalyst on a visible horizon
Founder-led, or a substantial insider stake
A reverse-DCF shows the catalyst is not already in the price
process: Patience, informational or catalyst. If none can be declared, the answer is pass.
Three passes or fewer is a pass unless the failure is explicitly justified.
Ten years explicit plus a terminal value at an 8% cost of capital: what growth does the price require? Then the two-axis screen against forward return on capital.
Which cluster it joins, what that cluster becomes as a share of risk, and whether it shares a kill-switch with anything held.
Trim a broken or overweight thesis, use fresh capital, or wait for a dated event. Never sell a live winner to fund a new idea.
A specific, checkable event. No kill-switch, no buy.

lessons.finding: Example: winners were sold early, before the thesis had paid.
lessons.rule: The holding period follows the declared edge, and reviews run on a schedule rather than on price moves.

lessons.finding: Example: a short burst of leveraged trading produced the largest single loss.
lessons.rule: Leverage and structured products are closed. Long-only equities only.

lessons.finding: Example: cheap valuations pointed to value traps more often than to mispricing.
lessons.rule: A reverse-DCF is used to falsify, never to rank.

rejected: Return on capital below the cost of capital once goodwill is included.

US8740391003.thesis: The only foundry that can make leading-edge AI chips at scale, and its lead widens with every capex cycle.
US8740391003.kill: Gross margin below 53% for two consecutive quarters, or a blockade or embargo of Taiwan.

US02079K3059.thesis: Search cash flows fund a full AI stack (TPUs, Gemini, Cloud) that the market still values like an advertising company.
US02079K3059.kill: Search revenue falls year on year for two consecutive quarters, or Cloud growth drops below 20%.

US5324571083.thesis: Leader in the fastest-growing drug class, with the oral pill and retatrutide as the next dated catalysts.
US5324571083.kill: Mounjaro and Zepbound revenue falls quarter on quarter, or the retatrutide filing slips beyond 2027.

US67066G1040.thesis: Sells the picks and shovels of AI with a software moat, while a record buyback supports the share count.
US67066G1040.kill: Gross margin below 71% for a full quarter, or a sequential fall in data-centre revenue.

CA2926717083.thesis: The only US mill that processes both uranium and rare earths, still narrated as a small uranium miner.
CA2926717083.kill: Uranium term price below $70/lb, or no commercial rare-earth oxide sales by the end of 2027.

US5951121038.thesis: Sold-out high-bandwidth memory with most of 2027 contracted at higher prices.
US5951121038.kill: Next-quarter guidance cut below consensus, or HBM contract prices fall.

US92537N1081.thesis: Power and liquid cooling scale with every GPU generation.
US92537N1081.kill: A second consecutive revenue miss, or book-to-bill below 1.0.

US5533681012.thesis: The West's integrated rare-earth and magnet producer, starting shipments to GM.
US5533681012.kill: Magnet shipments to GM not started by Q2 2027, or China lifts its export curbs.
